applied.quote: For a 12 to 17 year old, a Trump Account is usually a weak choice, because its value depends on years of growth.
applied.replacement: For a 12 to 17 year old, the case for a Trump Account rests on how many years remain before the money unlocks.
applied.why: SOURCE gives no verdict on worth or a causal claim about value.

applied.quote: The money is locked until January 1 of the year the child turns 18, so a 15 year old gets under three years of tax-deferred growth, a much weaker case than for a newborn.
applied.replacement: The money is locked until January 1 of the year the child turns 18, so a 15 year old gets only a few years of tax-deferred growth.
applied.why: "Under three years" and the newborn comparison are not in SOURCE.

applied.quote: For a teen, open a Trump Account to collect the Dell $250, and put larger savings in the alternative that fits the goal.
applied.replacement: For a teen, check Dell eligibility first, and put larger savings in the alternative that fits the goal.
applied.why: SOURCE says Dell $250 only may be received, and only for 2016-2024 births.
